services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. This clinic oversees patients with Latent Tuberculosis Infection and patients with Tuberculosis disease. Services are available on a referral basis for high-risk groups, including TB cases, contacts, and those with Latent TB Infection. The Port Arthur Health Department no longer provides TB skin tests for employment or for the public. The City of Port Arthur website is operated and funded by the City.
